description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Cost Controller to monitor production costs, analyze financial performance, identify cost optimization opportunities and support business decisions through accurate reporting and financial insights.

Join our Finance Team and contribute to our continued success!

 

Requirements:

  • University degree in Finance, Accounting or Economic Engineering;
  • 5+ years of experience within the automotive parts manufacturing industry;
  • Experience in budgeting, forecasting, and cost control across projects or business areas;
  • Strong Excel skills;
  • Knowledge of SAP is mandatory;
  • Fluent in English (both written and spoken), knowledge of German is a plus;
  • High attention to detail, proactive attitude, strategic thinking and solution-oriented mindset;
  • Strong team player.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Understands the business environment;
  • Performs monthly, yearly and ad-hoc cost calculations for factory-manufactured products;
  • Calculates labor hourly rates, machine tariffs and overhead costs;
  • Applies management accounting and cost allocation principles;
  • Performs month-end closing and reporting activities;
  • Assesses and analyzes financial performance deviations and recommends corrective actions;
  • Develops scenarios and business cases;
  • Reviews financial transactions and ensures cost accounting accuracy;
  • Contributes to financial planning, budgeting, reporting and audits;
  • Collaborates with operational departments and the Finance Team;
  • Analyzes, reconciles and drives productivity initiatives to achieve cost reductions;
  • Anticipates financial risks and identifies business opportunities;
  • Monitors CAPEX expenditure against budget;
  • Prepares accurate financial reports and provides analytical insights.

About us 

JOYSONQUIN Automotive Systems Romania produces steering wheels and ornamental elements for the dashboard, doors and center console, based on a modern technology and the diversity of materials used: noble veneer, leather, carbon and plastic. For over 20 years we have been satisfying the needs of our clients, renowned car manufacturers, such as Mercedes, Bentley, Audi, BMW, Porsche and Volkswagen. The quality of the products and the trust that our customers give us are the result of the professionalism of our employees. The company has 1000 employees in Ghimbav, Romania and is constantly developing.
